name: squeeze_floor_inf_rejected
description: AC-1 / M-2: a +Inf squeeze_floor is rejected at entry with ValueError. An infinite floor would clamp every squeezed stop up to pre_squeeze unconditionally (silently disabling the squeeze) -- a mistuned value that must surface loudly, not coerce. squeeze_floor is the string sentinel 'inf'.
derivation: squeeze_floor is +Inf. _reject_non_finite(squeeze_floor=inf) raises ValueError at function entry.
